subject: ADR 0005 harness-model routing portal + alias families; agents flagship proven live on omarchy
result: Portal design landed as PR ai-kit#319 (branch agent/alias-family-portal-adr, docs/examples only, pre-integration with C3): docs/adr/0005 names four primitives (harness, model route, profile, alias family) and fixes ownership (ai-kit registries/catalogue/credential/alias verbs; Actuation route realisation + AgentRef law; Workcell place grants; O-I config plane owner verbs for refs only; keychain the only key home; UI07 the only key path). Flagship example examples/alias-families/agents/ = the live omarchy agents command (herdr-default room over pi 0.85.1 / hermes 0.19.0 / codex 0.154.0, persistence via workcell places #83, opt-in herdr-server unit; disconnect/reconnect/server-restart/reboot semantics proven; evidence Work/O-I/campaign-evidence/2026-09-15-launcher-portal/TESTS.md). Mac parity path: epi successor expressed as an alias family (sesh-to-room, code-to-route launchers, slot-to-catalogue). Discovery found UI07 exposure on the Mac: claude-reset in ~/.zshrc exports a literal API key and ~/.claude/profiles/*.conf carry token literals — migration to keychain refs is ADR Stage 2, owner decision, untouched by us. Stage 1 = aikit alias verbs (to be built).
